create_thread: create a new thread with optional thread_id and metadata via POST /api/threads
delete_thread: delete a thread by ID removing filesystem data, store record, and checkpoints via DELETE /api/threads/{thread_id}
search_threads: search and list threads with metadata, status, limit, and offset filters via POST /api/threads/search
patch_thread: patch thread metadata by merging new fields into an existing thread via PATCH /api/threads/{thread_id}
get_thread_state: get the latest state snapshot for a thread including channel values and checkpoint info via GET /api/threads/{thread_id}/state
